preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 20.
The length of strings A and B must be between 1 and 1000.
Strings A and B must have the same length N.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Strings A and B must contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to convert A to B, the output must be -1.
The number of operations K must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= Z <= N for Z in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation must specify a valid number of indices Z.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= index < N for index in all_indices)
postconditions.description: All indices in the operations must be valid indices of the strings.
